comments.why: Shows Twitter running Scala on GraalVM in production.
comments.text: >If you are a startup then Scala isn't a good fit. FAANG don't need to use Scala because.... Not a FANG, but close, Twitter is a huge Scala shop and was one of the first to run Scala workloads on GraalVM in production. Twitter’s Quest for a Wholly Graal Runtime by Chris Thalinger: [VIDEO]

comments.author: luu
comments.story: A Race of Two Compilers: GraalVM JIT versus HotSpot JIT C2 [video]
comments.why: Twitter talk claiming significant performance gains from Graal.
comments.text: It seems pretty good. Twitter has some talks on this where they claim signifiant performance improvements: [VIDEO] . I've heard that the Twitter JVM team has a road show where they've talked to some other large Scala users about the performance improvements. Initially, people are highly skeptical of the claims, but after trying Graal on their internal workloads, they generally see similar results. Here's a paper which has some explanations for why you might expect Graal to improve Scala performance: [LINK]
